budget: Both arms 100epochs, batch256 BCE, 1000updates each. Each update forwards all 2558 cached rows and evaluates all 32437 same-video pairs; A rank is diagnostic only, B differentiates it. Same updates, not identical backward cost.
gate: VAL single global whole-tie cutoff >=95% correct retention each domain/video/all; B same-count and exact same-CR FA nonincrease vs A/simple/score each group, strict overall gains; correct FR run nonincrease; at least one Real video strict same-CR simple FA gain and strictly better error AUROC than both A and simple.
initialization: Torch seed1701 standard FP32 initialization cast to common FP64; deepcopy; last weight/bias and beta zero; smoke discarded.
loss: A: full-TRAIN-class-balanced genuine size BCE. B: same BCE + 0.25 within-video genuine bad/good full Cartesian ranking loss, per-video means then equal video mean.
normalization: Reuse historical TRAIN-only native PCA256 and TRAIN259D moments. No trained neural head/risks as inputs; only frozen formal simple anchor.
pair_construction: All genuine TRAIN bad x good within identical sequence, sorted image identity; no synthetic boxes, score mining, cross-video pairs, pair sampling or new splits. 32437 pairs from 71 bad frames, not independent events.
readout: sigmoid(logit(anchor)+0.5*tanh(g(x))); exact-neutral expm1 equivalent for risk; BCE uses logit form
scope: Frozen delivered M B24+sigma1.5 epoch03; replace only size risk/flag. No new detector/feature forward, synthetic boxes, new data roles or historical head reuse.
stop: Fail any gate: keep original M/simple, no TEST, no coefficient/capacity/activation/epoch/threshold search or A reselection.
